Test Title: Verify successful login with valid registered email and password
Preconditions: Active employee account exists; internet connected
Test Steps: 1. Open app 2. Enter email 3. Tap Continue 4. Enter password 5. Tap Sign In
Expected Result: User authenticates and navigates to HRMS Dashboard
Actual Result: Authenticates and navigates to Dashboard home screen

Test Title: Verify login error handling with invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Enter invalid password 3. Tap Sign In
Expected Result: Displays inline error toast without crashing
Actual Result: Error message displayed; user remains on password screen

Test Title: Verify validation on malformed email address and blank identifier
Test Steps: 1. Leave blank and tap Continue 2. Enter malformed email
Expected Result: Inline validation error appears; request blocked
Actual Result: Client-side validation highlights error state

Test Title: Verify Forgot Password OTP request and reset workflow
Test Steps: 1. Tap Forgot Password 2. Enter registered email 3. Tap Send OTP
Expected Result: OTP sent successfully; navigates to OTP verification screen
Actual Result: OTP request triggers verification workflow

Test Title: Verify login behavior with trailing whitespace and mixed-case email
Test Steps: 1. Enter email with spaces and uppercase 2. Tap Continue 3. Submit password
Expected Result: App trims whitespace and normalizes email casing to lowercase
Actual Result: Trim and lowercase sanitization succeeds

Test Title: Verify Dashboard widgets and employee summary loading
Test Steps: 1. Open dashboard 2. Verify greeting, clocking dashlet, leave cards, quick action tiles
Expected Result: All widgets render within 2 seconds without layout broken states
Actual Result: Dashboard renders header, clocking dashlet, leave cards accurately

Test Title: Verify pull-to-refresh on Dashboard updates real-time attendance & leaves
Test Steps: 1. Drag down from top of dashboard 2. Observe refresh spinner and API sync
Expected Result: Refresh spinner animates and syncs latest data from backend
Actual Result: Dashboard refreshes data successfully

Test Title: Verify dashboard behavior when company announcements list is empty
Test Steps: 1. Open dashboard with empty announcements payload 2. Observe announcements card
Expected Result: Section collapses gracefully without rendering broken containers
Actual Result: Section collapses gracefully

Test Title: Verify quick navigation and back-stack handling across all bottom navigation tabs
Test Steps: 1. Tap Attendance tab 2. Tap Leave tab 3. Tap Payroll tab 4. Tap hardware back
Expected Result: Navigation transitions smoothly; back stack preserved
Actual Result: Navigation stack preserved correctly

Test Title: Verify successful Clock-In punch with GPS location within office geofence
Preconditions: Employee assigned office shift; GPS permission granted
Test Steps: 1. Open Attendance 2. Verify GPS location 3. Tap Clock In 4. Confirm punch
Expected Result: Punch recorded; status changes to Clock Out; daily log updated
Actual Result: Punch recorded successfully; state changes to Clock Out

Test Title: Verify Clock-In rejection when GPS location is outside geofenced radius
Test Steps: 1. Open Attendance punch 2. Tap Clock In
Expected Result: Punch rejected with geofence distance warning message
Actual Result: Alert displayed; punch blocked by geofence validation

Test Title: Verify Clock-In prompt when Location Permission is denied by user
Preconditions: Location permission Denied in OS settings
Test Steps: 1. Open app 2. Tap Clock In on dashboard
Expected Result: App displays rationale modal with Open App Settings CTA safely
Actual Result: Permission prompt / settings dialog displayed safely

Test Title: Verify Attendance behavior on Network Drop / Airplane Mode during punch
Test Steps: 1. Tap Clock In 2. Disconnect Wi-Fi immediately 3. Observe app state
Expected Result: App times out gracefully with network retry CTA without corrupting state
Actual Result: Infinite spinner / unhandled promise rejection (BUG-05)

Test Title: Verify Mock Location / Fake GPS detection during attendance punch
Preconditions: Mock location provider enabled in Dev Options
Test Steps: 1. Enable mock GPS 2. Tap Clock In in Kredily app
Expected Result: App detects mock provider and rejects punch with security warning
Actual Result: Punch passes through without mock provider check (BUG-02)

Test Title: Verify rapid multi-tap / double-click prevention on Clock-In CTA
Preconditions: User on Clock-In screen on slow 3G network
Test Steps: 1. Rapidly tap Clock In button 5 times within 1 second
Expected Result: CTA disables on first tap to prevent duplicate API requests
Actual Result: Button debounce works; single request dispatched

Test Title: Verify successful leave application within available leave balance
Test Steps: 1. Tap Apply Leave 2. Select Casual Leave 3. Pick tomorrow 4. Enter reason 5. Submit
Expected Result: Application submitted; status set to Pending Approval; balance deducted
Actual Result: Leave application submitted and displayed in leave log

Test Title: Verify validation error when requesting leave exceeding available balance
Test Steps: 1. Select Sick Leave 2. Select 5 working days 3. Submit
Expected Result: Validation error appears: Requested days exceed available balance
Actual Result: Validation triggers and blocks submission

Test Title: Verify Leave Date Picker validation when End Date is before Start Date
Test Steps: 1. Select Start Date: 28-Sep 2. Select End Date: 20-Sep 3. Submit
Expected Result: Date picker prevents selecting past end date or shows validation error
Actual Result: Inverted date accepted and submitted to server (BUG-03)

Test Title: Verify leave application spanning across public holidays and weekends
Test Steps: 1. Apply leave Friday to Tuesday 2. Check calculated leave days
Expected Result: Calculates net 2 working days excluding weekend and holiday
Actual Result: Working day deduction calculated accurately as 2 days

Test Title: Verify viewing monthly payslip breakdown and downloading PDF
Test Steps: 1. Open Payroll tab 2. Select previous month 3. Verify breakdown 4. Tap Download PDF
Expected Result: Salary figures displayed accurately; PDF downloads to device storage
Actual Result: Payslip breakdown rendered and PDF download initiated

Test Title: Verify payslip screen display when payroll has not been generated for cycle
Test Steps: 1. Open Payroll tab 2. Select current month
Expected Result: Informative message displayed; download button disabled
Actual Result: Informative message displayed; download CTA disabled

Test Title: Verify masked CTC / salary figures when privacy toggle is enabled
Test Steps: 1. Tap Eye / Privacy toggle icon 2. Observe masked figures
Expected Result: All salary numbers masked with dots without layout distortion
Actual Result: Privacy masking works as expected

Test Title: Verify employee personal and work information display
Test Steps: 1. Open Profile tab 2. Inspect Personal Info, Work Info, Bank details
Expected Result: All records match backend database entries without missing fields
Actual Result: Profile sections render data accurately

Test Title: Verify profile image upload with oversized file and invalid format
Test Steps: 1. Tap Change Photo 2. Select 16MB PDF file
Expected Result: Validation error shown: Please upload image under 5MB
Actual Result: File picker limits to image types and enforces size constraint
